• This gallery is a selection from two other galleries featuring a compilation book of the artist's Taimanin R-18 works, focusing exclusively on the character Onisaki Kirara. You can view the complete originals via the links:

1 - https://e-hentai.org/g/2488865/fab698810c/
2 - https://e-hentai.org/g/1846570/ac58baca38/

• This 8-page doujinshi is actually the exclusive bonus booklet from the Winter Comiket C97 event, featuring Kirara Senpai,the voluptuous tsundere Taimanin from Taimanin RPGX.

• I would like to ask a professional translator to create an English version of this doujinshi.
n: [Doujinshi] [Garyuh-Chitai (TANA)] To think the day would come when I’d be pinned down by Kirara-senpai while she’s in the middle of masochistic training... (Taimanin Series)
